data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root 'h-m-d', meaning to praise or extol. In Islamic tradition, Mehmuda is a name for one who is blessed, pure, and chaste. The name Mehmuda carries the meaning “Blessed, Pure, Chaste” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mehmuda usually hope their child will grow to embody blessed, pure, chaste and live with faith, good character and purpose.

Mehmuda is therefore a name that inspires one to strive towards self-improvement and spiritual growth, ultimately seeking closeness to Allah.
